buildMiniApp.title: Build a small app from scratch
buildMiniApp.description: Droid builds a polished habit tracker, runs it, and shows you how to open it.
buildMiniApp.prompt: Build a polished single-page habit tracker from scratch in a new folder: add, check off, and delete habits, show a seven-day streak, and keep data in local storage. Run it, check that it works, and tell me how to open it.

weighTechChoice.title: Weigh a technical decision
weighTechChoice.description: Compare two options with current sources and get a clear recommendation.
weighTechChoice.prompt: Help me choose between Postgres and MongoDB for a new multi-tenant SaaS app. Research current sources, compare them on data modeling, scaling, operations, and cost, and end with a clear recommendation and the trade-offs I am accepting.

tourDroid.title: See what Droid can do
tourDroid.description: A short live demo that needs no setup.
tourDroid.prompt: Give me a quick tour of what you can do. Suggest three impressive things you could do right now without any setup on my side, then do the most impressive one live.

competitorTeardown.title: Tear down a product
competitorTeardown.description: Workflows, pricing, and positioning of a product you name, with sources.
competitorTeardown.prompt: Do a product teardown of Notion: core workflows, pricing tiers, positioning, and where users complain most, using current public sources. Cite your sources and end with three opportunities a competitor could exploit.

draftPrd.title: Draft a PRD from an idea
draftPrd.description: Turn a one-line feature idea into a structured spec.
draftPrd.prompt: Turn this feature idea into a PRD: "Let users schedule reports to be emailed weekly." Cover the problem, users, goals and non-goals, requirements, success metrics, and open questions, and save it as a Markdown file.

interviewGuide.title: Plan customer interviews
interviewGuide.description: A screener, a discussion guide, and a synthesis outline.
interviewGuide.prompt: Plan customer discovery interviews for a B2B expense-reporting tool: write a five-question screener, a 30-minute discussion guide with follow-up probes, and a synthesis outline, all in one Markdown doc.

landingPagePrototype.title: Prototype a landing page
landingPagePrototype.description: A polished, responsive page you can open in your browser.
landingPagePrototype.prompt: Prototype a polished, responsive landing page for a fictional coffee subscription brand as a single HTML file: hero, features, pricing, testimonials, and footer. Run it and tell me how to open it in my browser.

designSystemStarter.title: Start a design system
designSystemStarter.description: Color, type, and spacing tokens on one reference page.
designSystemStarter.prompt: Create a starter design system as one HTML reference page: color, type, and spacing tokens as CSS variables, plus buttons, inputs, and cards in light and dark themes. Run it and tell me how to open it.

critiqueSite.title: Critique a live website
critiqueSite.description: A UX review of any public page, with concrete fixes.
critiqueSite.prompt: Do a UX critique of https://stripe.com: hierarchy, copy, navigation, accessibility, and conversion. Rank the ten most important issues and give a concrete fix for each.

saasModel.title: Build a revenue model
saasModel.description: A 24-month SaaS model with inputs you can change.
saasModel.prompt: Build a 24-month revenue model for a SaaS startup as an Excel file: inputs for starting customers, growth rate, churn, and price per tier, with monthly MRR, ARR, and a chart. Use sensible example numbers I can change.

unitEconomics.title: Work through unit economics
unitEconomics.description: CAC, LTV, and payback on example numbers, with formulas.
unitEconomics.prompt: Walk me through unit economics for a subscription business with example numbers: calculate CAC, LTV, LTV to CAC, and payback period, show every formula, and put it in a spreadsheet I can reuse.

budgetTemplate.title: Create a budget vs. actuals sheet
budgetTemplate.description: A ready-to-fill spreadsheet with variance and a chart.
budgetTemplate.prompt: Create a budget versus actuals spreadsheet for a 20-person team: monthly budget and actuals by department, variance in amount and percent, conditional formatting for overspend, and a summary chart. Fill it with example data.

researchMarket.title: Research a market
researchMarket.description: Investigate a competitor or topic, with sources.
researchMarket.prompt: Research the market for AI meeting-notes tools: the main players, their positioning and pricing, and gaps in the market. Use current sources, cite them, and summarize what a new entrant should do.

launchPost.title: Write a launch post
launchPost.description: A crisp announcement for a product you describe.
launchPost.prompt: Write a launch blog post for a fictional product called Tidy, an app that cleans up your inbox automatically. Give me a punchy headline, 400 words, three social posts, and a short email to existing customers.

contentCalendar.title: Plan a month of content
contentCalendar.description: Weekly themes, channels, and first-week drafts.
contentCalendar.prompt: Plan a month of content for a B2B SaaS brand: weekly themes, channels, and post ideas in a spreadsheet, plus full drafts for the first week.

accountBrief.title: Prep an account brief
accountBrief.description: Research a prospect and build talking points.
accountBrief.prompt: Prepare an account brief on Shopify for a first sales call: what they do, recent news, likely priorities, key people, and five tailored talking points. Use current public sources and cite them.

draftOutreach.title: Draft outreach that lands
draftOutreach.description: Write a short, specific email sequence.
draftOutreach.prompt: Write a three-email outreach sequence to a VP of Operations at a mid-size logistics company, selling a workflow automation tool. Keep each email under 120 words, specific, and with one clear ask.

objectionHandling.title: Prep for objections
objectionHandling.description: The common pushbacks and a crisp answer to each.
objectionHandling.prompt: Create an objection-handling guide for selling a B2B SaaS product: the ten most common objections (price, timing, competitor, security, and more), a crisp response to each, and a question to keep the deal moving.

writeSop.title: Write an SOP
writeSop.description: A clear procedure with owners, steps, and checklists.
writeSop.prompt: Write a standard operating procedure for onboarding a new employee in their first week: owners, step-by-step tasks by day, checklists, and common pitfalls, as a clean Markdown doc.

mapProcess.title: Map a process
mapProcess.description: A flowchart of steps and owners, plus a simpler version.
mapProcess.prompt: Map a typical purchase-order approval process as a Mermaid flowchart with owners and handoffs, point out the bottlenecks, and propose a simpler version alongside it.

statusTemplate.title: Design a weekly update
statusTemplate.description: A reusable status format, filled with an example.
statusTemplate.prompt: Design a reusable weekly status update for an operations team: sections, the questions each should answer, and a filled-in example, short enough to read in two minutes.

competitorScan.title: Size up a competitor
competitorScan.description: Research a rival and where you can win.
competitorScan.prompt: Ask me which competitor to look at, then research what they ship, how they price and position themselves, and where a smaller team could win. Cite current sources.

investorUpdate.title: Draft an investor update
investorUpdate.description: Shape your highlights into a crisp, confident update.
investorUpdate.prompt: Help me draft a monthly investor update. Ask me for this month's highlights, metrics, lowlights, and asks in one short message, then shape them into a crisp, confident update I could send today.

pitchOutline.title: Outline a pitch deck
pitchOutline.description: A 10-slide story and what each slide must prove.
pitchOutline.prompt: Outline a ten-slide seed pitch deck: the story arc, what each slide must prove, and the questions investors will ask about it. Ask me for a one-line description of my company first.

craftDeliverable.title: Craft a deliverable
craftDeliverable.description: Produce a polished doc, PDF, or spreadsheet.
craftDeliverable.prompt: Create a polished one-page PDF guide to running effective meetings, with a short checklist and a simple diagram. Tell me where you saved it.

researchTopic.title: Research any topic
researchTopic.description: A sourced briefing on something you are curious about.
researchTopic.prompt: Give me a sourced briefing on the current state of nuclear fusion energy: where the technology stands, the main players, and what to watch for in the next five years. Keep it to one page and cite current sources.

dirtyBranch.title: Finish the work on {{branch}}
dirtyBranch.description: Changed files: {{fileCount}}. Droid finishes the work and runs the checks.
dirtyBranch.prompt: I have uncommitted changes in {{fileCount}} files on the branch {{branch}}. Review them, work out what I was in the middle of, finish it, and run the relevant tests and checks. Summarize what you changed.
dirtyBranch.promptWithoutBranch: I have uncommitted changes in {{fileCount}} files in {{repo}}. Review them, work out what I was in the middle of, finish it, and run the relevant tests and checks. Summarize what you changed.

branchReview.title: Review {{branch}} before a PR
branchReview.description: Checks its changes against {{defaultBranch}} for bugs and gaps.
branchReview.prompt: Review the branch {{branch}} against {{defaultBranch}}: read its commits, look for bugs, missing tests, and unfinished work, and fix what you find. End with a short pull request description I can paste.

runTests.title: Run {{repo}}'s tests
runTests.description: Finds how the tests run, runs them, and fixes what fails.
runTests.descriptionWithToolchain: Finds how the tests run with {{toolchain}}, runs them, and fixes what fails.
runTests.prompt: Work out how the tests run in {{repo}}, run them, and fix any failures. Summarize what you fixed.
runTests.promptWithCommand: Run the tests in {{repo}} with `{{command}}`. If anything fails, find the cause and fix it, then run them again until they pass. Summarize what you fixed.
runTests.promptWithToolchain: Work out how the tests run in {{repo}} (it is set up with {{toolchain}}), run them, and fix any failures. Summarize what you fixed.

explainRepo.title: Explain how {{repo}} works
explainRepo.description: The main parts, how they connect, and where to start reading.
explainRepo.prompt: Explain how {{repo}} is structured: the main parts, how they connect, and how a request or command flows through it. Point me to the files I should read first.
explainRepo.promptWithLanguage: Explain how {{repo}} is structured: the main parts, how they connect, and how a request or command flows through it in this {{primaryLanguage}} codebase. Point me to the files I should read first.

multiRepo.title: Trace how {{first}} and {{second}} connect
multiRepo.description: The APIs, calls, and shared code between them, as a diagram.
multiRepo.prompt: This environment has {{repositories}}. Trace how they connect: the APIs, calls, and shared code between them. Draw it as a Mermaid diagram and point out anything fragile.

addTests.title: Add tests to {{repo}}
addTests.description: Covers the important code that has no tests yet.
addTests.prompt: Find the most important code in {{repo}} that has no tests, add focused tests for it, and run them. Tell me what you covered and why.

lint.title: Fix lint errors in {{repo}}
lint.description: Runs {{command}} and fixes what it reports.
lint.prompt: Run `{{command}}` in {{repo}} and fix everything it reports without changing behavior. Run it again to confirm it is clean.

findBug.title: Find and fix a bug in {{repo}}
findBug.description: Finds a real bug, explains it, and fixes it with a test.
findBug.prompt: Look through {{repo}} for a real bug: a crash, a wrong result, or an unhandled edge case. Explain it, fix it, and add a test that would have caught it.
